title: The office runs the operation
journey: A staff member signs in, the panel reads within their ward scope, they write through a callable, the callable re-reads the live staff doc, and the write happens only if the staff member is still active.

steps.action: A staff member signs in; mintStaffToken reads staff/{staffId} and mints the token with role, staffId and the live wardIds scope.
steps.notes: The scope comes from the live doc, not a form field; a revoked staff member's token stays valid up to an hour, so every later write re-reads the staff doc.

steps.action: The panel reads within the staff member's ward scope: vans, trips and complaints limited to the routes/wards of their staff scope.
steps.notes: Read-only within scope; the admin panel does not read whole collections.

steps.action: The office writes through a callable: setComplaintStatus, publishNotice, upsertDriver, upsertStaff, setVanDepot or markWardDutyCompleted.
steps.notes: Every admin write goes through a callable because the token's claims are a snapshot and can be up to an hour old.

steps.action: The callable re-reads staff/{staffId}.active; if false, the write is rejected with notAuthorised even though the token is still live (instant revocation).
steps.notes: This is Q5 / ADR-0003: a revoked staff member loses access immediately because the server checks the live doc.

slices.evidence: src/App.tsx routes 25 screens (A01_Login through A25_AuditLog, routed pairs A01_Login/A1_Login, A3_LiveMap/A15_LiveMap, A4_Complaints/A17_Complaints); src/services/dataService.ts reads and writes localStorage under prefix safai_v3_; src/services/firebaseConfig.ts exists but no Firebase calls are made.
slices.blockedBy: The admin panel has zero Firebase; its data layer is a pure localStorage mock and it calls no callable.

slices.evidence: 04-functions/src/callables/admin.ts contains real callable code, but callables.json marks every admin callable lifecycle as planned.
slices.blockedBy: No app calls these callables; the admin panel has no Firebase, so mintStaffToken is never invoked and every admin write targets localStorage.

handoffs.notes: The staff member signs in and the panel receives the token with the ward scope.
The office write lands in Firestore only after the live staff re-read passes.

scenario.name: Admin dispatch: sign in, read scope, write through callable, revocation
steps: A staff member signs in; mintStaffToken reads staff/{staffId} and mints the token.
The panel reads vans, trips and complaints within the staff ward scope.
The office resolves a complaint through setComplaintStatus.
Revoking staff/{staffId}.active makes the next callable write fail with notAuthorised even with a live token.

openQuestions: The admin panel has zero Firebase; every admin-dispatch write targets localStorage. Decide when to wire mintStaffToken and the admin callables.
The admin panel's routed screens include duplicated pairs (A1_Login/A01_Login, A3_LiveMap/A15_LiveMap, A4_Complaints/A17_Complaints); confirm which of each pair is canonical.
The user app's stack is React/Vite, not Flutter as the PRD states; the admin panel is React+Vite, not Next.js.
